title: A database switchover interrupts nobody's film
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "Nothing breaks the viewers' evening. Upgrades, a lost machine and a database failover happen without interrupting anyone." The engine answers some requests with an error during a database switchover today.
acceptanceCriteria: A switchover or restart of Postgres during films costs no viewer their stream, their place or a subtitle; at most a moment of buffering, shown on Media3 and in a browser.
Nothing is refused for a moment the database was away, and nothing is remembered as failed because of it.
notes: Coarse: sharpened when stage 2 is planned in detail.
